headline: Warden Counters in Marban Hollow as Weathered Expanse Grinds Down Salient
war_summary: Since the morning edition, fierce counter-thrusts have altered the contested sectors across the front. In Marban Hollow, renewed assaults around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall enabled Warden forces to retake ground, shifting the tally to two Warden strongholds, four Colonial posts, and two neutral ruins. In the Weathered Expanse, unrelenting attrition around Crow’s Nest and Shattered Advance cost the Wardens two bastions, leaving them clinging to a single position while five remain under Colonial control and three lie abandoned. Kuura Strand witnessed further Warden gains, solidifying a second redoubt to split the district four to two in Colonial favor. Along the Nevish Line, Colonial forces reclaimed vacated outposts near Princefal, restoring an even four-to-four partition as casualties sharply accelerated. Fighting in Linn of Mercy paused over the past two hours, preserving a lone Warden salient, while Godcrofts stabilized under full Colonial jurisdiction following six sharp morning transfers at Argosa and Lipsia. Meanwhile, butcher’s bills cooled dramatically in Callahan’s Passage, though Dead Lands flared with over twelve hundred fresh casualties despite static lines.
